# GPU review dependency

`fpl-gfx` is a source snapshot from `ajmwagar/gfx` local verified commit
`447227efbc518cbb80b81050784785287e0cadb7`, with its manifest, original licenses,
source, examples and benches. No targets, credentials or caches are included.
The shared egui pass was implemented in the gfx owner first. This QA package
uses that pass for PNG exports; it is not an Android runtime dependency.
